description: Compact provenance snapshot for the offline finalist comparison cited in README.md

metric_definitions.quality_retained_percent: Mean quality divided by the always-highest-training-mean-cost model's mean quality
metric_definitions.cost_savings_percent: Savings in dataset-native replay cost relative to the benchmark reference
metric_definitions.routing_latency_ms: Router CPU time measured during the recorded offline replay
metric_definitions.model_calls_per_request: Selected generation-model attempts per held-out replay row

evidence_limit: This snapshot makes the reported comparison source-auditable. It is not a self-contained benchmark reproduction because the large RouterBench dataset, replay rows, and TrustRouter benchmark harness are deliberately outside this model-only repository.
